title: The selected saving lies below the one-cell ceiling bracket
body:
## Summary
- The published ceiling bracket has width exactly `1/10^15`.
- The selected saving `kappa/(1-kappa) = 836330098538459/499163669901461541` is strictly below the lower endpoint.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no exponential evaluation.
